newsitem.title: USA: NBC wins Nielsen tv ratings for March 10 week.
newsitem.headline: NBC wins Nielsen tv ratings for March 10 week.

text.p: NBC's top rated Thursday night lineup kept the network on top of the prime time television viewership ratings for the week of March 10 through March 16, Nielsen Media Research said.
NBC, a unit of General Electric Co, posted 9.9 rating points with a 17 percent share with the network's Thursday night programs holding five of the seven top most-watched shows, Nielsen said.
Seinfeld won first place for the week, followed by Friends, Suddenly Susan and Naked Truth, said Nielsen, a unit of Cognizant.
The rating points represent a percentage of homes with televisions and the share represents the percentage of television sets tuned in at a particular time.

Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS finished in second place, keyed by Touched by an Angel at number 5, news program 60 Minutes at number 6 and its Sunday night movie Stolen Women, Captured Hearts at number 12, Nielsen said.
CBS posted a 9.1 rating with a 16 share, Nielsen said.
ABC, which is owned by Walt Disney Co, ranked third with a 8.5 rating and a 14 percent share.
A rating of 7.4 put News Corp's Fox in fourth place, Nielsen said.
Viacom Inc's UPN and Time Warner Inc's WB networks posted ratings of 3.5 and 2.9, respectively, Nielsen said.
